spatial_scale.display_projection: one isotropic span shared by x/y/z and all telescopes
spatial_scale.marker_radius: fixed screen pixels for visibility; not a physical length

emission_reconstruction.point_kind: derived from each raw 2D photon bunch; not an explicit 3D EventIO field
emission_reconstruction.assumption: straight-line propagation from zem altitude to the receive plane

provenance.ray_boundary: Photon x/y, cx/cy, time and zem are read directly from the local 4 GB EventIO file. The 3D emission point is derived from the raw receive-plane anchor, raw direction and raw zem using the same unit/sign convention as EventIOPhotonSource.cpp.
